timeline.tweet: I know what it's like to simply exist like a anemone. Not a life but an existence. I know what it's like to not want to eat, not shower, sleep all day, cry, and wish it would end. Not life necessarily ending but for the depression to go away. #SickNotWeak #domoreag
This disease isn't simple or easy or one size fits all. As someone who has this disease my job is to talk & share. We can help by reaching out. When I feel down I depend on others. That's 100% ok.

I'm so proud of him! As someone who has depression and anxiety, I fully realize the want or need to keep this disease a secret. However, I now speak up and tell the world because I know it helps so many people know they're not alone. My love to and his family ❤.
